subject: Package manager
claim: Use pnpm, not npm or yarn; the workspace is a pnpm monorepo and lockfile is pnpm-lock.yaml

subject: Contract calls
claim: Never call an ENSv2 contract function that is absent from a vendored ABI in engine/core/abis; pnpm check:abi enforces it

subject: contenthash
claim: Never hand-roll a contenthash prefix; encode with @ensdomains/content-hash using the ipfs/swarm allow-list and round-trip check

subject: Universal Resolver
claim: Read ENS through the documented UniversalResolverV2 (0x4A18…), not the 0xeEeE vanity proxy, which was re-pointed to an undocumented registry set on 15 Sep 2026

subject: Token ids
claim: Never cache ENSv2 token ids; they change on role changes — resolve by label every time

subject: Storage access
claim: All storage goes through the StorageAdapter interface; no direct Pinata or Bee calls outside engine/storage

subject: MCP server
claim: The MCP server never holds a funded wallet; knowledge_push refuses unless PRIVATE_KEY is present in that process

subject: Console builds
claim: Verification builds of the console use NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-verify so they never clobber a running dev server's .next

subject: Public copy
claim: Competitor products are named in public copy only in the dedicated comparison page, and always fairly — they are telling the truth about what they claim

subject: Naming
claim: Namespaces are named for subjects (food.rishikesh.eth), never for writers or sources; the writer goes on the claim
